name: chaos channeler
mana cost: {2}{R}{R}
types: creature human shaman
power toughness: 4/3
triggered: wild magic surge — whenever CARDNAME attacks, roll a d20.
option[1]: 1—9 | exile the top card of your library. you may play it this turn.
option[2]: 10—19 | exile the top two cards of your library. you may play them this turn.
option[3]: 20 | exile the top three cards of your library. you may play them this turn.
